name: Olhos de Ressaca
source:
A visual novel based on Brazil's most iconic 19th-century novel. Follow Capitu from adolescence to adulthood and choose where your heart leads. Bentinho or Escobar? Loyalty or freedom? The ending is yours to decide. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4788780/Eyes_Like_the_Tide/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部根据巴西最具代表性的19世纪小说改编的视觉小说。跟随Capitu从青春期到成年，选择你的心所向往的地方。本蒂尼奥还是埃斯科瓦尔？忠诚还是自由？结局由你决定。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4788780/Eyes_Like_the_Tide/]Steam[/url]]
